The weather was cloudy that day. Tom is interested in reading. Leo wrote about the day in the diary. Best of all, the shark's fin cut slowly through the water.
Leo and Tom had great fun there. There are always many people at the family dinner table. Leo spent the weekend at the zoo. The twin sisters dress alike and even laugh alike.
Both of them like fish and juice. Leo thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Tom's birthday is in April.
